Frequently asked questions

Which regulations do these courses follow?
  • OSHA Welding, Cutting, and Brazing for Construction Training: in accordance with Federal OSHA Regulations 29 CFR 1926 Subparts J and Z.
  • OSHA Focus Four Struck-By Hazards Prevention for Construction Training: in accordance with Federal OSHA Regulations related to struck-by hazards under 29 CFR Part 1926. 29 CFR 1926.501, 29 CFR 1926.302, 29 CFR 1926.1400, and 29 CFR 1926.601.
  • OSHA Hand and Power Tools Safety Training: in accordance with Federal OSHARegulations 29 CFR 1926 Subpart I.
  • OSHA Steel Erection Safety Training: in accordance with Federal OSHA Regulation 29 CFR 1926 Subpart R.
  • OSHA Competent Person for Basic Rigging and Inspection Training: in accordance with Federal OSHA Regulations 29 CFR 1926.251 and 29 CFR 1926 Subpart CC.
How long does OSHA Construction Safety Training take?
  • OSHA Welding, Cutting, and Brazing for Construction Training: 1 hour.
  • OSHA Focus Four Struck-By Hazards Prevention for Construction Training: 1 hour.
  • OSHA Hand and Power Tools Safety Training: 2 hours.
  • General Safety and Health Provisions Training for Construction: 1 hour.
  • OSHA Concrete and Masonry Awareness Training: 1 hour.
  • Rigging Safety Awareness Training: 1 hour.
  • OSHA Steel Erection Safety Training: 2 hours.
  • OSHA Competent Person for Basic Rigging and Inspection Training: 6 hours.

Training is self-paced, so you can stop and pick up where you left off at any time.

How long do I have to finish?

You get a 3-month completion timeline, 1-year access to training materials.

Do I get a certificate?

Yes. You can download your certificate of completion as soon as you pass the final exam.

  • OSHA Welding, Cutting, and Brazing for Construction Training: valid 36 months
  • OSHA Focus Four Struck-By Hazards Prevention for Construction Training: valid 12 months
  • OSHA Hand and Power Tools Safety Training: valid 36 months
  • General Safety and Health Provisions Training for Construction: valid 36 months
  • OSHA Concrete and Masonry Awareness Training: valid 36 months
  • Rigging Safety Awareness Training: valid 12 months
  • OSHA Steel Erection Safety Training: valid 12 months
  • OSHA Competent Person for Basic Rigging and Inspection Training: valid 24 months
Can I take the training on my phone?

Yes. The training is 100% online and works on phones, tablets and computers, 24 hours a day.

Can I buy training for my whole team?

Yes. Enter the number of seats at checkout. Team pricing starts at 2 seats and goes up to 10% off for 501–1,000 seats. For larger orders or invoicing, call 1‑866‑429‑6742.

Is the training available in Spanish?

These courses are available in English and Spanish:

  • OSHA Welding, Cutting, and Brazing for Construction Training
  • OSHA Hand and Power Tools Safety Training
  • OSHA Steel Erection Safety Training
  • OSHA Competent Person for Basic Rigging and Inspection Training

The others are in English.

How do I start my course after I pay?

Right after checkout you'll get an email with your receipt and your login for the learning portal. Sign in at hazwoper-osha.com to begin.

Who provides the training?

Courses are delivered by HAZWOPER OSHA Training, LLC on its online learning portal at hazwoper-osha.com. Questions? Call 1‑866‑429‑6742.

What is the refund policy?

See the refund policy on hazwoper-osha.com, or call us before you start a course.
